title: An AI Data Scientist with the Pandas DataFrame Agent in Colab
summary: Scott Askinosie walks through a Colab lab where a LangChain agent analyzes a CSV using OpenAI.
learn: The pandas DataFrame agent in LangChain Experimental is the "brain": it writes code to answer questions about your data.
Set the LLM temperature to 0 when you want facts, and turn verbose on to see the steps the agent takes.
With error handling on, the agent inspects the generated code before it runs; if the code is bad it sends it back to try again.
In the demo on Starbucks drink data, the agent explains what the data is, suggests where to start and reports 242 rows and 18 columns.
You can ask for summary statistics, a bar chart and a correlation heat map, then a subjective question like the healthiest drink.
